source: Chinmay, in session, on the AI system design draft
rule: AI design questions are ours to answer; none was make-or-break, so none goes to the client

decisions.a: Yes; our own models per tenant

Per-tenant AI residency class (ADR-0009, amended 2 October). UAE-only, the default and mandatory for government, bank and health tenants: Small = Core42 Compass GPT-4.1 mini (or GPT-4.1 Arabic 'Seraj' if it wins the Arabic golden set), Strong = Compass GPT-5, fallback OpenAI UAE (the in-cell gpt-oss-120b fallback was dropped on 3 October: we host no model unless a client asks, and the guard is the provider's content-safety service; CHG-R1S-002); Compass is reached through AiProviderKind openaiCompatible and billed through Azure Marketplace. Global allowed (a private venue opts in under PDPL Art. 23 with a vendor contract, DPIA and notice): Azure gpt-5-mini / gpt-6-sol Global Standard or the tenant's BYOK provider, fallback the UAE-only chain. On-premise: Qwen3.5 or gpt-oss; Strong Qwen3.5-122B, Falcon-H1 Arabic or Jais 2. Scale step: the UAE-only Small tier moves to Azure UAE North PTU (spillover off) when steady traffic nears about 100,000 calls a day. Billing stays per token, per selected module (3 packages plus custom; module prices configured by TICVAI). Vendor terms in writing before signing (DEC-541, open).

decisions.a: A second AI engineer from 5 October; no third (Chinmay, 30 September). The trained model producers slip first; everything with a baseline ships in the six months

decisions.q: AI model billing when a client picks its own provider or model
decisions.a: Closed: with BYOK the AI engine maps each AI task to the client provider's equivalent model from TICVAI's curated range (tiers, not model names; docs/active/research/ai-ml-model-selection-2-october.md section 2.3), and usage is billed to the client's own key. Any BYOK provider other than OpenAI's UAE region is a cross-border transfer, so BYOK fits the Global-allowed residency class only (ADR-0009 section 3).
decisions.a_before: DEFERRED, not decided: to the dedicated AI workshop (client meeting 30 September, MoM 4.1; Allam). Position stated on the call, for the workshop to confirm: the AI agents behave the same whichever model a client selects, with only minor performance variation; we propose a recommended model per function; any extra cost of a provider or model the client chooses (for example ChatGPT) is borne by the client. Until the workshop, AI-D02 (managed Azure OpenAI, re-billed per token) stands as the default

decisions.q: Which models may run each AI and ML task
decisions.a: TICVAI curates a range per AI and ML task: the best-suited model plus 3-4 alternatives where they exist (generative tiers Small, Strong, Reasoning; embeddings, reranking, moderation, PII detection, OCR and speech are platform-owned and never BYOK; every money path stays classical ML). The range is recorded in the AI design and seeded in the AI model catalogue; the individual picks are the research's recommendations (docs/active/research/ai-ml-model-selection-2-october.md sections 1 and 3) until the golden sets confirm them.
